Eight bifolia, with the same 100-word measure and color scale as the Bio map.
Each rectangle is a recorded word box. Warm = lower diversity; teal = higher diversity.
Unique forms / preceding 100 words (including this word)
Path 1 study order; not established chronology. Colors carry history across pages. Mean bars exclude incoming windows.
